sample_1.prompt: Japanese anime style illustration. A cheerful anime girl with short brown hair in a school uniform standing in a bright library, surrounded by towering stacks of colorful books piled high on every shelf and on the floor around her. She looks amazed and happy. Soft warm lighting, detailed background, vibrant colors, high-quality anime art style.

sample_2.prompt: Japanese anime style illustration. A busy Japanese train station platform packed with a large crowd of anime-style commuters in various outfits. Overhead signs glow in the background. An anime boy with a backpack stands in the foreground looking at the crowd with wide eyes. Dynamic composition, detailed urban background, vivid colors, high-quality anime art style.

sample_3.prompt: Japanese anime style illustration. Two anime students sitting at a cluttered desk late at night, surrounded by a lot of papers, textbooks, and sticky notes. An hourglass sits beside them. One girl looks stressed, the other is focused and writing. A window in the background shows a starry night sky. Warm lamp light, cozy yet busy atmosphere, high-quality anime art style.
